notes: A five-component archive/filesystem pipeline in one Python program (solve.py) driven from a workspace dir and generalized over hidden inputs. (1) list-archive-members-to-surface-token: the manifest.zip holds several near-identical config.yaml members at different logical paths plus decoy tokens; only the exact path manifest/release/current/config.yaml carries the real app_token, so choosing the wrong member yields a different token and fails the content check. (2) exclude-path-patterns during packaging: out/release.zip must drop vendor/ and __pycache__ dirs, any *.pyc/.o/.tmp/.cache file, and restricted-permission files (mode 000), while precision probes like vendor.py / tool.o.txt (which only look like exclusions) must be kept. (3) deep.tar.gz must carry the relative symlink intact (not dereferenced) and must not truncate deeply nested or >100-char-long member names (PAX). (4) mirror tree: every *.dat.gz under mirror_src is decompressed into out/mirror/ under its original basename. (5) answer.json must contain the token and the exact per-file sha256 map of every file under data/hash, and the source tree must remain byte-for-byte unchanged (source-modification check fails on any mutation). hidden_case_generalization=3: three genuinely different fixtures (different tokens/names, spaces in names, deeper nesting, varied package/arbitrary member sets) are re-run through /app/solve.py. debugging_ambiguity=2: near-duplicate archive paths, decoy tokens, and exclusion-rule precision probes force reading member lists rather than guessing. Medium bucket (total 14).
